milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining spruce_wood blocks causes them to drop as items into the player's inventory. The scene places minecraft:spruce_wood blocks (all-bark variant, confirmed in sandbox with correct texture) at spawn-relative positions (3,0,3) and (5,0,-3). The player has an iron_axe to mine efficiently. When mined via left-click, spruce_wood drops itself as an inventory item. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per design philosophy.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must locate and observe the spruce_wall_sign. The sign is placed at spawn-relative coordinates (-3, 2, -4) on the east face of the cobblestone structure, confirmed visible in sandbox frames (steps 005, 014, 019 of run 2). max_distance=16 is generous given the sign is only ~7 blocks from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the sign (not just nearby with back turned). This is the preferred rule type for find/locate/observe tasks.
